official: 文京区行政手続条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年2月定例議会 議決結果

name: 行政手続の通知方法を見直す
summary: 現在の規定では、公示による通知の事項を書面にして、行政庁の事務所の掲示場に掲示する方法が定められています。この議案では、公示事項を不特定多数が閲覧できる状態にし、掲示場への掲示か、事務所に設置した電子計算機の画面での閲覧を可能にします。措置を始めてから2週間で通知が届いたものとみなし、令和8年5月21日に施行します。
changes: 「名あて人」の表記を「名宛人」に改める
公示事項を規則で定める方法で不特定多数が閲覧できる状態に置く
公示事項を書面で掲示場に掲示するか、事務所内の電子計算機の画面で閲覧できるようにする
公示の措置を始めて2週間後に通知が到達したものとみなす
who: 不利益処分の通知を受ける人
why: 行政手続法の一部改正に伴い、聴聞などの通知方法を見直し、規定を整備するためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Reviews how notices are given in administrative procedures
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Bunkyo City Administrative Procedures Ordinance
en.summary: Under the current rules, matters to be notified by public notice must be put in writing and posted on the notice board at the administrative agency’s office. This bill makes public-notice matters available for viewing by an unspecified number of people, either by posting them on a notice board or by making them viewable on a computer screen at the office. Notice is deemed to have been received two weeks after the measure begins. The ordinance takes effect on May 21, 2026.
changes: Changes the notation for “addressee” from 「名あて人」 to 「名宛人」
Makes public-notice matters available for viewing by an unspecified number of people, using methods set by rules
Allows public-notice matters to be posted in writing on a notice board or viewed on a computer screen inside the office
Deems notice to have been received two weeks after the public-notice measure begins
who: People receiving notice of an adverse disposition
People who may be notified by public notice
People who may view public notices
People deemed to have received notice by public notice
en.why: The ward says this is to review how notices for hearings and other matters are given following a partial amendment to the Administrative Procedure Act, and to update the related provisions.
